candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Dohľad (supervision hub: námietky, kontrola, správne delikty, Rada úradu)
candidates.why_relevant: Master entry point of the Slovak procurement review body (Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie) linking every remedy/oversight register: objections, review of contracting authority's acts, administrative offences (fines), inspections and the Council's appeal decisions. Everything in this coverage cell hangs off these subsections.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Seed crawler on /dohlad subsection index; enumerate child registers monthly and diff link sets to detect new decision batches
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + direct fetch of ÚVO supervision section
queries_used: ÚVO rozhodnutia námietky verejné obstarávanie register rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Prehľad rozhodnutí o námietkach (všeobecná agenda)
candidates.why_relevant: Decision-by-decision listing of objection (námietky) rulings. For banking/payments tenders (bankové služby, platobné karty, akceptácia platieb, POS terminály) these decisions disclose bid values, evaluation criteria, disqualified bidders and grounds for cancellation that the award notice never shows.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML scrape of the listing + PDF download of each decision; full-text index and filter on banking/payments glossary terms
queries_used: ÚVO rozhodnutia námietky verejné obstarávanie register rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Prehľad rozhodnutí o námietkach (strategická agenda)
candidates.why_relevant: Separate track for strategic/large-value procurements (typically EU-funded or nationally significant). Large bank-service, cash-handling or payment-infrastructure contracts for ministries and state agencies are more likely to land here.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Same scraper as general agenda, distinct listing URL; confirm exact slug on first crawl
queries_used: ÚVO rozhodnutia námietky verejné obstarávanie register rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Zbierky rozhodnutí (curated decision collections / good-practice digests)
candidates.why_relevant: ÚVO's own thematic digests of decisions issued in objection proceedings — compact way to learn recurring failure patterns (e.g. conditions of participation, references, pricing) that shape how banking/payment tenders are written and contested in SK.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly PDF harvest + summarisation
queries_used: ÚVO rozhodnutia námietky verejné obstarávanie register rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Správne delikty (administrative offences / fines register)
candidates.why_relevant: Sanction decisions naming contracting authorities fined for procurement breaches. Retrospectively exposes contracts awarded without proper competition — including direct awards of bank/payment services — with contract values and legal reasoning.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape listing, download decision PDFs, extract authority name, contract subject, value, fine
queries_used: Rada Úradu pre verejné obstarávanie odvolanie rozhodnutie zverejňovanie uvo.gov.sk

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Kontrola (ex-ante / ex-post inspection decisions)
candidates.why_relevant: Inspection outcomes, including ex-ante assessment of high-value procurements. Ex-ante files can reveal a banking/payments tender's design before award, an early-warning channel.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML scrape + PDF harvest, monthly
queries_used: ÚVO rozhodnutia námietky verejné obstarávanie register rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: Rada ÚVO – Prehľad rozhodnutí (appeal body decisions)
candidates.why_relevant: Second-instance appeal decisions against ÚVO rulings; the fullest legal record of a contested tender. Note a legislative change: the Council was made transitional and handles appeals against decisions issued up to 31 Dec 2022, so post-2022 second-instance review may sit elsewhere (chairman of the Office / courts) — the historical archive remains highly valuable.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off historical backfill of the archive plus low-frequency re-check; verify current second-instance channel
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on Rada úradu + site index
queries_used: Rada Úradu pre verejné obstarávanie odvolanie rozhodnutie zverejňovanie uvo.gov.sk

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Register osôb so zákazom účasti vo verejnom obstarávaní (debarment register)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory register (§183 Act 343/2015) of economic operators debarred from public procurement by final decision — the sanction endpoint of bid-rigging and misrepresentation cases. Directly relevant when screening SK bidders/partners in payments and IT integration.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly snapshot of the register listing / published PDF export; diff for new entries

negative_findings.description: None of the SK oversight/remedy registers found (ÚVO námietky, správne delikty, PMÚ decisions, NKÚ audits) offers a sector/CPV filter that would isolate banking, payments or card-acceptance contracts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches combining remedy terms with banking terms (bankové služby, platobné karty) returned generic register landing pages, not sector-filtered result sets.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be full-corpus harvest plus own keyword classification; a naive query-only approach will miss most banking/payments cases.

negative_findings.description: No PMÚ SR bid-rigging decision specifically covering banking or payment services was identified in this pass; the prominent recent cartel cases surfaced were in energy and EU-funded construction/IT.
negative_findings.result_summary: PMÚ enforcement news found related to energy sector cartel (fines over EUR 7.2m, 2023) and EU-funds bid rigging; no banking/payments case observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-claiming; the payments channel may still exist inside IT/software cases, so IT-sector decisions must be read for payment-infrastructure subject matter.

negative_findings.description: The Rada ÚVO (Council) appears to have been made transitional, handling appeals only against decisions issued up to 31 Dec 2022 and ceasing to exist thereafter; the current second-instance route was not conclusively established.
negative_findings.result_summary: ÚVO/secondary sources state the Council's temporary nature; no authoritative page confirming the successor appeal route was retrieved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must not assume the Council remains the live appeal channel; misrouted monitoring would silently miss post-2022 appeal decisions.

negative_findings.description: Only the ÚVO /dohlad page was fetched directly in this pass; all other URLs come from search results and were not individually fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are recorded with confidence scores, not liveness claims; several ÚVO paths are http:// legacy CMS links that may redirect.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve legacy uvo.gov.sk paths (e.g. /dohlad/rada-uradu/referencie/prehlad-rozhodnuti) before they are treated as stable endpoints.

negative_findings.description: A Slovensko.Digital red-flag/procurement monitoring tool was hypothesised but not confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: The targeted query returned Transparency International Slovensko material only; no Slovensko.Digital procurement analytics product surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leaves a possible civic-tech analytics layer unmapped; should be re-queried with SK terms 'Slovensko.Digital', 'Otvorené zmluvy', 'Red flags index'.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level oversight actors touching SK procurement — OLAF, EPPO (Slovakia participates), European Court of Auditors, and the CJEU/General Court on SK infringement cases — were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on OLAF/EPPO press releases mentioning Slovensko + verejné obstarávanie, ECA special reports on SK cohesion spending, and CURIA for SK procurement preliminary rulings.

coverage_gaps.description: Domestic financial-control actors other than NKÚ — Ministerstvo financií SR (Sekcia auditu a kontroly / vládny audit), Úrad vládneho auditu, and managing authorities' irregularity findings on EU-funded contracts — are unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'Úrad vládneho auditu správa', 'vládny audit verejné obstarávanie', 'nezrovnalosť riadiaci orgán korekcia' and map their publication registers.

coverage_gaps.description: Criminal-side oversight (Generálna prokuratúra SR, NAKA / Úrad boja proti korupcii, Špecializovaný trestný súd) which prosecutes procurement manipulation was not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map prosecution/court publication practice for procurement corruption cases; note that indictments often name contract values and intermediaries.

coverage_gaps.description: No machine-readable API or bulk export was confirmed for ÚVO decisions, PMÚ decisions, or NKÚ reports; NKÚ's list uses Liferay portlet pagination and ÚVO decisions are PDFs on fileadmin paths.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe for open-data endpoints on data.slovensko.sk for these publishers; otherwise budget for PDF-harvest + OCR/text-extraction pipeline with stable document-ID capture.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin: ÚVO, NKÚ and PMÚ publish substantive decisions almost exclusively in Slovak; only EU-level pages provide EN framing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for SK-language full-text search and machine translation in the pipeline; do not rely on EN queries to discover cases.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth of the ÚVO decision registers (how far back the online listings reach, and what moved to /dohlad/archiv) was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate https://www.uvo.gov.sk/dohlad/archiv and the fileadmin/dokumenty/rozhodnutia_* directories to determine earliest available year before designing the backfill.

brief: Slovakia's procurement remedy and audit trail is concentrated in four institutions with well-defined but PDF-heavy public registers: ÚVO (objections, review of contracting authority acts, administrative-offence fines, inspections, the transitional Rada ÚVO appeal body, and the statutory debarment register), NKÚ SR as supreme audit institution (audit protocols, summary reports, and a forward-looking list of ongoing audits), PMÚ SR for bid-rigging/cartel decisions plus its transparency document portal, and the courts via Slov-Lex, justice.gov.sk and the commercial aggregator Judikáty.info for administrative review of ÚVO and PMÚ decisions. These channels are the main way banking and payments contract details — bid values, disqualifications, cancelled and re-run tenders — become visible after the fact, since award notices routinely omit them. The binding constraint is not availability but retrievability: none of the registers offers sector or CPV filtering, decisions are published as PDFs on legacy CMS paths, and no confirmed API or bulk export was found, so collection must be full-corpus harvest with in-house keyword classification against a Slovak banking/payments glossary. Aggregators (Uvostat, Judikáty.info) and watchdog output (Transparency International Slovensko) are useful discovery and redundancy layers but must always be resolved back to the primary decision document before anything is asserted.
